title: Reliable and Efficient Amortized Model-based Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring language model performance as a function of speaker dialect using African-American-aligned versus White-aligned tweets (TwitterAAE dataset), and evaluating multiple-choice question answering in ambiguous contexts involving subjects of different races (BBQ dataset).

Using the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) dataset to measure social biases (including gender, race, and physical traits) via multiple-choice question answering in ambiguous versus unambiguous contexts.
Evaluating stereotypical associations through multiple-choice question answering scenarios involving subjects with different professions (e.g., construction worker vs. surgeon) using the BBQ dataset.
Assessing biases and toxicity in open-ended text generation using the BOLD (Bias in Open-Ended Language Generation) dataset and prompted generations using the RealToxicityPrompts dataset.
